key_insight: CAR makes AI research ideation inspectable through literature-grounded transformation traces, while explicit operators show no consistent quality advantage over free-form iteration.
engineering_relevance: Research-agent pipelines can use knowledge-graph retrieval and logged conceptual transformations to inspect how proposals develop and which literature sources they declare.
method: Build a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature.
Iteratively develop ideas using graph retrieval and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration.
Check operator calls against structural acceptance conditions and record transformations and declared sources.
evidence_signal: Across two model backbones, 40 LiveIdeaBench topics and two execution benchmarks, CAR outperformed single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist on methodological novelty and achieved the highest pairwise execution win rate among evaluated AI methods.
watch_item: No methodological-novelty contrast in the ten-condition ablation survived multiple-comparison correction, limiting claims about which components improve idea quality.
paper_title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
